title: api: introduce v2 request/response schema behind beta header with back-compat shims and deprecation warnings
author: Maya Thompson
description: Summary: Add an opt-in v2 API request/response schema behind the X-Redwood-API-Version: 2 beta header, provide server-side back-compat shims to translate v1 clients, and add deprecation warnings for removed/renamed fields. Motivation: enable incremental rollout of structured-output and tool-calling improvements without breaking existing clients; provide a clear migration path and telemetry for adoption. Changes: 1) new canonical schema files (api/schema/v2/*.json) and a schema migration layer in server/handlers/api_versioning.go; 2) an OpenAI compatibility adapter that translates common OpenAI-style payloads to Redwood v2 shapes in compatibility/openai_adapter.go and SDK adapters; 3) runtime behavior: when X-Redwood-API-Version: 2 is present, the server validates/generates v2 shapes; when absent, server applies shims that map legacy fields into v2 internal representation and emits Deprecation-Warning headers; 4) streaming stability tweaks to the stream manager to ensure chunk alignment with v2 structured-envelope boundaries; 5) docs and SDK compat shims updated. Backwards compatibility: default behavior remains unchanged for v1 clients. The beta header is required to opt into the v2 contract; only customers who set the header will see any breaking differences. Testing: unit + integration tests covering translation shims, deprecation header emission, and streaming envelope alignment. Rollout plan: feature gated, staged rollout behind a kill-switch; telemetry (versioning_metrics) records header presence and shim usage to inform migration. See linked Linear tickets for migration playbook and telemetry. Related: ENG-4321, ENG-4380.

release_notes: Optional v2 API schema behind X-Redwood-API-Version: 2 (beta). Server-side back-compat shims translate common v1 payloads so default behavior is unchanged. Deprecation-Warning header emitted for deprecated fields. OpenAI compatibility adapter updated to bridge common OpenAI-style requests to Redwood shapes. Streaming envelope alignment improved for structured v2 responses. No changes are visible to clients unless they opt into the beta header.
notes_for_release: Operators: to enable v2 for a tenant set the X-Redwood-API-Version header to '2' in requests or enable the header at the gateway routing layer. Monitor 'redwood.api.version.header_count' and 'redwood.api.version.shim_usage' to track adoption. Rolling back simply removes the header. For dedicated/private customers coordinate with account team if using pinned model variants.
